subject: Fixing gamma and epsilon parameters in colext

messages.author: 8158366b3cf54333
messages.subject: Fixing gamma and epsilon parameters in colext
parts:
Hi Everybody

 

I am building occupancy models to understand factors driving seasonal shifts in occupancy and detection of mammal species in Andean habitats. To define the most appropriate analysis, I would want to fit both full multi-season model and model where colonization and extinction are fixed to zero (no change).


How can I fix the gamma and epsilon parameters to 0 in dynamic model (colext) in R?


I tried with “gammaformula = ~ 0” and  “epsilonformula = ~ 0”, but it didn´t work!!!


Thanks for the suggestions


Camilo Sánchez

messages.author: 247b990d236a7af6
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Fixing gamma and epsilon parameters in colext
parts:
I'm sure I'm not understanding what you want to do.  To be able to "understand factors driving seasonal shifts in occupancy" by fitting a model that does not allow for change in occupancy doesn't make any sense to me nor do I think that colext can fit such models.

My guess is that you'd like a parameterization of a dynamic occupancy model where the logit of the occupancy probability is a linear function of predictors without having to specify a model for colonization and extinction probabilities.

Could you respond with more details as to what you want to do or "Yes, you're very confused.".

Thanks,

Jim
